claim_boundary.physical_mirror_claim_requires: every preregistered connected constant-psi component and quantile passes v3 field, topology, uncertainty, and electron-adiabaticity gates
claim_boundary.default_publication: rank, nullity, residual and conservation diagnostics only; no state, power or performance

source_policy.polarity: strict stage-alternating; inner/outer equivalent-current sheets remain paired

topology.geometry_cusp_slots: one upstream return-field slot at first_stage_center-0.75*pitch followed by all three adjacent-stage midplanes
topology.boundary_null_policy: finite-box boundary nulls are diagnostics only and never cells or plasma closures
topology.contour_connectivity_policy: every component at every quantile must be one simple closed non-boundary contour

cell_distribution_reduction.nominal: arithmetic mean over every accepted quantile/component
cell_distribution_reduction.lower: minimum covered lower bound over every accepted quantile/component
cell_distribution_reduction.upper: maximum covered upper bound over every accepted quantile/component

plasma_network.topology_rule: N=4 only when the accepted v3 record has exactly four stable geometry-registered cells/cusps
plasma_network.mapping: first three bounded cell distributions define ordered interior edges; fourth defines the anode-arrival boundary
plasma_network.probability_interval_propagation: nominal plus every vertex of the four-dimensional lower/upper probability box

failure_taxonomy.GEOMETRY_INVALID: strict geometry or manufacturing identity failed
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_PRIMARY_INVALID: primary L1a map or evidence gate failed
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_DOWNSAMPLED_INVALID: independent lower-resolution L1a map or evidence gate failed
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_ENLARGED_INVALID: independent enlarged-domain L1a map or evidence gate failed
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_DOMAIN_UNSTABLE: enlarged-domain boundary metric exceeded the preregistered comparison
failure_taxonomy.TOPOLOGY_COUNT: a map did not contain exactly four accepted interior cusps
failure_taxonomy.TOPOLOGY_GEOMETRY_REGISTRATION: a cusp did not match its preregistered geometry slot
failure_taxonomy.TOPOLOGY_ENDPOINT: a cusp was inside the endpoint exclusion region
failure_taxonomy.TOPOLOGY_UNSTABLE: cell count or cusp positions changed across maps
failure_taxonomy.CONTOUR_OPEN: a required constant-psi component was open or boundary-truncated
failure_taxonomy.CONTOUR_DISCONNECTED: a required component was disconnected, branched, retraced, self-intersecting or saddle-ambiguous
failure_taxonomy.CONTOUR_NULL: a required same-contour field bound included an exact or near null
failure_taxonomy.COUPLING_UNCERTAINTY: covered complete field uncertainty invalidated a required quantile
failure_taxonomy.COUPLING_INVALID: a required v3 record or distribution could not be built
failure_taxonomy.PLASMA_INPUT_INVALID: bounded probabilities could not form an exact N=4 plasma topology
failure_taxonomy.PLASMA_NONCONVERGENCE: no strict residual root at at least one required interval scenario
failure_taxonomy.PLASMA_RANK_DEFICIENT: a residual root was not full-column-rank; unique state, power and performance publication prohibited
failure_taxonomy.PLASMA_UNIDENTIFIABLE_OBSERVABLE: a requested state-dependent observable varied across a validated nullspace direction

ranking.missing_stage_policy: rank by completed terminal gate only; no numerical fake penalty

execution.dependency_closure: all tracked blobs under the v2 experiment and imported cft_revival coupling, fields, geometry, magnetics, optimization, plasma and plasma_network package trees, plus pyproject and machine-readable ledgers/specifications
execution.zero_pass_policy: publish the immutable null result and failure taxonomy without patching or rerunning

result_lifecycle.pre_run: tests pass while results directory is absent
result_lifecycle.post_run: the same tests strictly validate sealed dataset, manifest, report, lock, representative artifacts and preregistration identity
